Validate configuration and print the normalized read-only execution plan

Usage: commit-ci-preflight plan [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --config <CONFIG>
          Configuration file to validate [default: .commit-ci-preflight.toml]
      --json
          Emit canonical machine-readable JSON
      --matrix-plan-profile <MATRIX_PLAN_PROFILE>
          Compatibility digest profile for Matrix V2 configuration [default: current-v2]
  -h, --help
          Print help
